rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 2BB/full blastocyst description, with reasonable comments on modest ICM and loose TE, but it overreaches by calling it possibly early hatching/over-expanded and mentions absence of degeneration/fragmentation that may not be confidently assessed from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, smoking, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality and prognosis, though some interactions (e.g., day-4 transfer implications, semen interpretation) are somewhat generalized.

Overall structure is logical, but there are internal inconsistencies and hedging around embryo stage and endometrial thickness, and the probability discussion shifts between ranges without a tightly justified final estimate.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF practice: recognizes 2BB as viable, supports single embryo transfer at age 29, avoids routine PGT-A in first cycle, and emphasizes smoking cessation. Minor deviations include somewhat speculative interpretation of thick endometrium and day-4 blastocyst framing.

Provides practical next steps including proceeding with SET, smoking cessation, cavity assessment if not done, luteal support adherence, and future-cycle review points. Useful and clinically oriented, though some recommendations remain broad rather than protocol-specific.
